name: tdarr
title: Tdarr
description: Goes through a media library and transcodes or remuxes the files that do not meet your rules, for example everything to H.265 or without unwanted audio tracks, and health-checks them. After deploying, add a library that points at /media with /temp as its transcode cache, and choose its plugins. It replaces the original files, so try it on a copy of a few files first.

variables.name: PORT_TDARR
variables.label: Web UI Port
variables.description: Port for the Tdarr web page

variables.name: PORT_TDARR_SERVER
variables.label: Server port
variables.description: Port that Tdarr nodes on other machines connect to

variables.name: TDARR_MEDIA
variables.label: Media folder
variables.description: The folder on this server with the files to work through, mounted at /media (writable: Tdarr replaces files)

variables.name: TDARR_TRANSCODE_CACHE
variables.label: Transcode cache
variables.description: Folder for files while they are being transcoded, mounted at /temp; needs room for the largest file

variables.name: TDARR_NODE_NAME
variables.label: Node name
variables.description: Name of the built-in node as the web page shows it
